question: Is yoga-eligibility one thing alone?
premises: it is to be done twofold, as cited by him
yoga-eligibility is not by this one alone
inference: Eligibility is constitutively twofold, never singular.
uncertainties: ekameva denied; duality of gate kept
plain_english: Twofold it is to be done, as cited by him — and yoga-eligibility would not be by this one alone.
